scope: Retrospective per-run pixel/count shape, timing-proxy sensitivity and apparent return; no independent metric gain, calibrated latency or slip certification.
input_source: Direct Rig STATE x/received_ns and raw vision.t/pivot_px only; SDK filters, old camera calibration and mirrored encoder unused.

timing_proxy.caveat: Board acquisition snapshot to host receipt proxy. Slope includes receipt jitter/trend; intercept includes unmeasured transport. Camera t is host-read, not exposure time.

camera.source: raw vision.pivot_px only; mirrored/fused fields ignored

shape.lag_definition: Compare pivot_x(t) with counted_x(t-lag); positive lag means camera pixels trail the receipt-mapped count. Same-run fitted, not calibrated latency.

cross_run_consistency.interpretation: Four different sign/amplitude conditions, not repeated trials at each condition; no statistical repeatability estimate. Different camera poses cannot be excluded from geometry alone.

caveats: Within-run pixel/count regression is descriptive and cannot establish independent cart metric scale or physical input gain.
Best lag is selected on these same observations and conflates receipt mapping, exposure/readout/processing, commanded/physical differences and detector jitter; it is not calibrated latency.
No missing camera points are filled. Counted x interpolation uses adjacent source states only and excludes gaps over30ms. Lag fits use identical common camera support.
Raw arm pivot may move with contour/pose estimation; no independent fixed-background landmark measurement is available here. Apparent offsets do not uniquely establish slip.
